svg.title: M11: A cited evidence investigation with host validation
svg.desc: The host freezes authorized evidence. Model call one extracts source statements and candidate links. The host corroborates and recalculates controls. Model call two organizes references without tools. The host renders exact facts and keeps source claims and hypotheses distinct.

g.text: M11 / NEMOTRON EVIDENCE INVESTIGATOR / PROPOSED
The model proposes. The host validates and calculates.
At most two foreground model calls • one-minute whole-case target remains unmeasured

g.title: Host owns scope, authorization and frozen source versions
g.text: 1 · M13 host opens the authorized case
Pin source versions and policy. Retrieve all required control inputs; select cited narrative excerpts.
Record source coverage, freshness and omitted context. The model does not define the denominator.

g.title: Only authorized bounded source content goes to the model
First model call extracts proposals, not authoritative facts
g.text: 2 · Nemotron call 1: extract
Quoted statements + source locations
Candidate relationships + contradictions
Propose at most one corroborating-read batch.

g.title: Host validates authority and recomputes controls
g.text: 3 · Host corroborates and checks
M12: source, scope, spans and authority
M07–M09: deterministic control calculations
Pin accepted-input revision; keep unresolved links.

g.title: Final as-of assessments and validated references go to composition
Second model call organizes validated references with no tools
g.text: 4 · Nemotron call 2: organize
Order validated facts, source claims and gaps.
Return a constrained explanation plan.
No tools, new extractions or verdict edits.

g.title: Host renders the explanation against pinned accepted inputs
Host fixes assessment values and citations in the output
g.text: 5 · M13 host renders and publishes
Insert exact assessment values and quotes.
Validate references; escape source content.
Record model provenance, timings and failures.

g.title: The case keeps operational results, source statements and hypotheses separate
g.text: One inspectable case, with different kinds of statement
Calculated result
10,800 actual tokens > 10,000 cap → 800 over. Illustrative source example.
Source statement
A cited note reports a timeout and retry. Verify its scope and exact wording.
Unproved hypothesis
That retry caused the overshoot. Do not present this as established fact.
A one-call first slice can skip model composition and use a fixed host template after validation.
